assessment_sessions_result_bounds_check.name: assessment_sessions_result_bounds_check
assessment_sessions_result_bounds_check.value:
("assessment_sessions"."measurement_evidence_count" IS NULL OR "assessment_sessions"."measurement_evidence_count" BETWEEN 0 AND "assessment_sessions"."expected_item_count")
        AND ("assessment_sessions"."measurement_correct_count" IS NULL OR "assessment_sessions"."measurement_correct_count" BETWEEN 0 AND "assessment_sessions"."measurement_evidence_count")
        AND ("assessment_sessions"."observed_accuracy" IS NULL OR "assessment_sessions"."observed_accuracy" BETWEEN 0 AND 100)
        AND ("assessment_sessions"."confidence_lower" IS NULL OR "assessment_sessions"."confidence_lower" BETWEEN 0 AND 100)
        AND ("assessment_sessions"."confidence_upper" IS NULL OR "assessment_sessions"."confidence_upper" BETWEEN 0 AND 100)
        AND ("assessment_sessions"."confidence_lower" IS NULL OR "assessment_sessions"."confidence_upper" IS NULL OR "assessment_sessions"."confidence_lower" <= "assessment_sessions"."confidence_upper")

assessment_sessions_state_coherence_chec.name: assessment_sessions_state_coherence_check
assessment_sessions_state_coherence_chec.value:
"assessment_sessions"."started_at" >= "assessment_sessions"."created_at" AND (
        ("assessment_sessions"."status" = 'started'
          AND "assessment_sessions"."measurement_evidence_count" IS NULL
          AND "assessment_sessions"."measurement_correct_count" IS NULL
          AND "assessment_sessions"."observed_accuracy" IS NULL
          AND "assessment_sessions"."confidence_lower" IS NULL
          AND "assessment_sessions"."confidence_upper" IS NULL
          AND "assessment_sessions"."terminal_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("assessment_sessions"."status" = 'submitted'
          AND "assessment_sessions"."measurement_evidence_count" IS NOT NULL
          AND "assessment_sessions"."measurement_correct_count" IS NOT NULL
          AND "assessment_sessions"."terminal_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "assessment_sessions"."terminal_at" >= "assessment_sessions"."started_at"
          AND (
            ("assessment_sessions"."measurement_evidence_count" = 0
              AND "assessment_sessions"."measurement_correct_count" = 0
              AND "assessment_sessions"."observed_accuracy" IS NULL
              AND "assessment_sessions"."confidence_lower" IS NULL
              AND "assessment_sessions"."confidence_upper" IS NULL)
            OR ("assessment_sessions"."measurement_evidence_count" > 0
              AND "assessment_sessions"."observed_accuracy" IS NOT NULL
              AND "assessment_sessions"."confidence_lower" IS NOT NULL
              AND "assessment_sessions"."confidence_upper" IS NOT NULL)
          ))
        OR ("assessment_sessions"."status" = 'abandoned'
          AND "assessment_sessions"."measurement_evidence_count" IS NULL
          AND "assessment_sessions"."measurement_correct_count" IS NULL
          AND "assessment_sessions"."observed_accuracy" IS NULL
          AND "assessment_sessions"."confidence_lower" IS NULL
          AND "assessment_sessions"."confidence_upper" IS NULL
          AND "assessment_sessions"."terminal_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "assessment_sessions"."terminal_at" >= "assessment_sessions"."started_at")
      )

assessment_skill_results_estimate_check.name: assessment_skill_results_estimate_check
assessment_skill_results_estimate_check.value:
(
        "assessment_skill_results"."evidence_count" = 0
          AND "assessment_skill_results"."status" = 'unassessed'
          AND "assessment_skill_results"."observed_accuracy" IS NULL
          AND "assessment_skill_results"."confidence_lower" IS NULL
          AND "assessment_skill_results"."confidence_upper" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "assessment_skill_results"."evidence_count" > 0
          AND "assessment_skill_results"."status" IN ('insufficient', 'observed')
          AND "assessment_skill_results"."observed_accuracy" BETWEEN 0 AND 100
          AND "assessment_skill_results"."confidence_lower" BETWEEN 0 AND 100
          AND "assessment_skill_results"."confidence_upper" BETWEEN 0 AND 100
          AND "assessment_skill_results"."confidence_lower" <= "assessment_skill_results"."confidence_upper"
      )

fsrs_cards_numeric_state_check.name: fsrs_cards_numeric_state_check
fsrs_cards_numeric_state_check.value: "fsrs_cards"."stability" >= 0 AND "fsrs_cards"."difficulty" >= 0 AND "fsrs_cards"."elapsed_days" >= 0 AND "fsrs_cards"."scheduled_days" >= 0 AND "fsrs_cards"."learning_steps" >= 0 AND "fsrs_cards"."reps" >= 0 AND "fsrs_cards"."lapses" >= 0

idempotency_records_lease_pair_check.name: idempotency_records_lease_pair_check
idempotency_records_lease_pair_check.value: ("idempotency_records"."lease_token" IS NULL AND "idempotency_records"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL) OR ("idempotency_records"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "idempotency_records"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

idempotency_records_device_sequence_chec.name: idempotency_records_device_sequence_check
idempotency_records_device_sequence_chec.value: ("idempotency_records"."device_id" IS NULL AND "idempotency_records"."device_sequence" IS NULL) OR ("idempotency_records"."device_id" IS NOT NULL AND "idempotency_records"."device_sequence" IS NOT NULL AND "idempotency_records"."device_sequence" >= 1)

learning_evidence_one_origin_check.name: learning_evidence_one_origin_check
learning_evidence_one_origin_check.value: (("learning_evidence"."attempt_id" IS NOT NULL) + ("learning_evidence"."session_id" IS NOT NULL)) = 1

lesson_sessions_form_all_or_none_check.name: lesson_sessions_form_all_or_none_check
lesson_sessions_form_all_or_none_check.value: ("lesson_sessions"."form_schema_version" IS NULL AND "lesson_sessions"."form_script" IS NULL AND "lesson_sessions"."form_manifest_json" IS NULL AND "lesson_sessions"."form_manifest_hash" IS NULL) OR ("lesson_sessions"."form_schema_version" IS NOT NULL AND "lesson_sessions"."form_script" IS NOT NULL AND "lesson_sessions"."form_manifest_json" IS NOT NULL AND "lesson_sessions"."form_manifest_hash" IS NOT NULL)

lesson_sessions_form_manifest_hash_check.name: lesson_sessions_form_manifest_hash_check
lesson_sessions_form_manifest_hash_check.value: "lesson_sessions"."form_manifest_hash" IS NULL OR (length("lesson_sessions"."form_manifest_hash") = 71 AND substr("lesson_sessions"."form_manifest_hash", 1, 7) = 'sha256:' AND substr("lesson_sessions"."form_manifest_hash", 8) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')

lesson_sessions_score_check.name: lesson_sessions_score_check
lesson_sessions_score_check.value: ("lesson_sessions"."raw_score" IS NULL OR ("lesson_sessions"."raw_score" >= 0 AND "lesson_sessions"."raw_score" <= 100)) AND ("lesson_sessions"."gate_score" IS NULL OR ("lesson_sessions"."gate_score" >= 0 AND "lesson_sessions"."gate_score" <= 100))

lesson_sessions_state_coherence_check.name: lesson_sessions_state_coherence_check
lesson_sessions_state_coherence_check.value:
"lesson_sessions"."started_at" >= "lesson_sessions"."created_at" AND (
        ("lesson_sessions"."status" = 'started'
          AND "lesson_sessions"."raw_score" IS NULL
          AND "lesson_sessions"."gate_score" IS NULL
          AND "lesson_sessions"."required_evidence_count" IS NULL
          AND "lesson_sessions"."required_correct_count" IS NULL
          AND "lesson_sessions"."passed" IS NULL
          AND "lesson_sessions"."submitted_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("lesson_sessions"."status" = 'submitted'
          AND "lesson_sessions"."form_schema_version" IS NOT NULL
          AND "lesson_sessions"."form_script" IS NOT NULL
          AND "lesson_sessions"."form_manifest_json" IS NOT NULL
          AND "lesson_sessions"."form_manifest_hash" IS NOT NULL
          AND "lesson_sessions"."raw_score" IS NOT NULL
          AND "lesson_sessions"."gate_score" IS NOT NULL
          AND "lesson_sessions"."required_evidence_count" IS NOT NULL
          AND "lesson_sessions"."required_correct_count" IS NOT NULL
          AND "lesson_sessions"."passed" IN (0, 1)
          AND "lesson_sessions"."submitted_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "lesson_sessions"."submitted_at" >= "lesson_sessions"."started_at"
          AND "lesson_sessions"."required_correct_count" BETWEEN 0 AND "lesson_sessions"."required_evidence_count"
          AND "lesson_sessions"."required_evidence_count" BETWEEN 0 AND "lesson_sessions"."expected_evidence_count")
        OR ("lesson_sessions"."status" IN ('abandoned', 'invalidated')
          AND "lesson_sessions"."raw_score" IS NULL
          AND "lesson_sessions"."gate_score" IS NULL
          AND "lesson_sessions"."required_evidence_count" IS NULL
          AND "lesson_sessions"."required_correct_count" IS NULL
          AND "lesson_sessions"."passed" IS NULL
          AND "lesson_sessions"."submitted_at" IS NULL)
      )

reader_sessions_state_coherence_check.name: reader_sessions_state_coherence_check
reader_sessions_state_coherence_check.value:
"reader_sessions"."started_at" >= "reader_sessions"."created_at" AND (
        ("reader_sessions"."status" = 'started'
          AND "reader_sessions"."correct_count" IS NULL
          AND "reader_sessions"."terminal_at" IS NULL
          AND "reader_sessions"."terminal_reason" IS NULL)
        OR ("reader_sessions"."status" = 'submitted'
          AND "reader_sessions"."correct_count" IS NOT NULL
          AND "reader_sessions"."terminal_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "reader_sessions"."terminal_at" >= "reader_sessions"."started_at"
          AND "reader_sessions"."terminal_reason" = 'completed')
        OR ("reader_sessions"."status" = 'abandoned'
          AND "reader_sessions"."correct_count" IS NULL
          AND "reader_sessions"."terminal_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "reader_sessions"."terminal_at" >= "reader_sessions"."started_at"
          AND "reader_sessions"."terminal_reason" IN ('user-exit', 'support-requested', 'superseded', 'reset-invalidated'))
      )
